pieces.name: O'Hare 2016D (interest)
pieces.why: This is one old airport bond's yearly interest to the people who lent the money, and it is already as small as the bond itself.

source.doc: O'Hare 2026CD official statement p.64 (balances) and Appendix H p.339-343 (refunded); 2025CD official statement Appendix H p.391-394 (tendered); each series' own statement cover (coupons)

pieces.note: Derived, not printed: balance after the 2026 refunding $392,740,000 x each maturity's coupon = $19,637,000 for the bond year Jan 2 2026 to Jan 1 2027. The balance ties to the 2026CD OS p.64 to the dollar after taking the Dec 2025 tender and the Jan 1 2027 refunding off the cover list (O'Hare_2016D-G_Sr._Lien_GARB_OS.bW9YWx6Cu3.pdf p.2). Series: General Airport Senior Lien Revenue Bonds, Series 2016D (Non-AMT). Fixed rate. Gross of any federal subsidy or pledged passenger/customer charges. The 2026 budget line was written before the 2026 refunding, so it may hold slightly more interest on bonds that were refunded in October 2026.

residual.name: Rest of the older bonds' interest (2016G and rounding)
residual.why: Series 2016G and small differences share this leftover. A 2025 refunding changed 2016G by an amount whose list we do not hold, so its balance does not tie and we do not guess.

splits.note: Five older bonds were taken out of the leftover, each balance times its interest rates, with the balance checked against the airport's own 2026 bond table. Their January 1 2027 principal (not placed in any box) is $54,310,000; the principal box for these older bonds is $46,676,911, so it cannot hold them all and was left alone.

side.label: Principal due 1/1/2027 after the 2026 refunding, by series (2016D, 2016E, 2017A, 2017C; 2018C has none until 2049). Not placed in the principal box because the sum is larger than that box.
